title: Object storage requests and streamed bodies honor cancellation and deadlines
steps: Run the object storage adapter tests against suite-owned local HTTP servers that stall headers or a body after its first bytes.
expect: PUT, GET, HEAD and DELETE abort stalled requests and close their connections.
A GET body remains subject to its deadline after response headers, and caller cancellation interrupts an active body read.
Successful response status, headers, URL and bytes remain intact; metadata-only operations cancel unused bodies.
Transport failures preserve false/null adapter results.
fence: native fetch AbortSignal deadline remains active through streaming response consumption

tests: object GET deadline remains active after headers and first bytes
caller cancellation aborts object GET body and PUT before the deadline
routed media storage preserves caller cancellation through real storage requests
